column1: # Postal address layouts, named by a country code the caller gives (`--with postal:de`, `format --layout de`):
# data of the engine, not a branch on the sheet's country (ANSWERS §60).
# {number} {street} {postcode} {city} {region} {neighborhood}; "\n" separates lines. An empty field is dropped
# with the separator next to it; an empty line is dropped. A country without a row uses the default.
